numerical_discrepancy.note: Claim says below $2.30 in most states; no state average was below $2.30. National average $2.94 — 64 cents above the claimed threshold.

summary: FactCheck.org found Trump 'continued to exaggerate the decline in gasoline prices.' As of Feb. 24, 2026, no U.S. state had an average regular-gasoline price below $2.30 (AAA state data; Oklahoma was closest at $2.37). The nationwide average was $2.94 (EIA, week ending Feb. 23). Prices did decline roughly 5% (about 17 cents) since Trump took office — directionally down, but the specific 'below $2.30 in most states' assertion is false in every state.
title: FactChecking Trump's State of the Union Address
